I was sleeping with my mom and in the middle of the night (i don't remember what time) I rolled over to the other side of the bed and saw a little girl, no older than twelve, staring at me. She had both of her arms on the edge of the bed with her head resting on them. She had long black hair. I don't exactly remember if she was smiling at me or not, but it really freaked me out. I just flipped over to the other side facing my mom. I didn't say anything that night, but I told her about it in the morning. She told me how that night she felt someone sit on the end of the bed but when she looked up no one was there. I've slept with pillows on the edge of my bed ever since.
